heading: Hold payslip
reasonRequired: Give a reason for the hold — it is stored against the payslip.
description: Holding removes this employee's net pay from the run total. Their payslip stays computed, so releasing it later needs no recalculation.
reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Bank details unverified — awaiting cancelled cheque.
reasonHint: Shown on the payroll register and to whoever reconciles the transfer.
